title: perf(cache): return None on cache miss instead of raising
body: Cache misses are now an ordinary `None` instead of an exception — raising on the hot path showed up in profiles. All call sites are updated to check for `None`.

files.diff:
@@ -8,5 +8,5 @@ def put_user(user):
 
 
 def get_user(uid):
-    """Return the cached user; raises KeyError on a miss."""
-    return _USERS[uid]
+    """Return the cached user, or None on a miss."""
+    return _USERS.get(uid)

@@ -2,8 +2,7 @@ from svc import cache, db
 
 
 def show_user(uid):
-    try:
-        user = cache.get_user(uid)
-    except KeyError:
-        user = db.load_user(uid)
+    user = cache.get_user(uid)
+    if user is None:
+        user = db.load_user(uid)
     return {"id": user.id, "email": user.email}
